summary: Forest Lookouts lists the Humphreys County tower as not standing; no other source found describes the Belzoni site.

facts.status_note: Listed as not standing; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Page is the Forest Lookouts page for the Belzoni tower
Page lists the tower as not standing

corrections.why: The page gives 'not standing' in the position the record uses for agency. That is a status, and the page names no agency.

notes_for_editor: Single source: a one-line status on a Forest Lookouts page. Two web searches, the Humphreys County history page and the Wikipedia Belzoni article gave no tower or lookout history. A guessed Forestry Commission wildfire plan URL for Humphreys County returned 404. Record agency holds 'not standing'; correction proposed. The story is short because the evidence is. Needs county or state forestry records or old local newspapers before it can grow.
